    Separation from Lemma 4.3 #

    Two arrows into a that end an essential contour with value μ lie in different components of the morphisms into a from a set D none of whose nonzero morphisms into a factors through μ (not_sepComp_of_essCfg): a joining sequence of comparabilities gives a walk of common upper bounds avoiding μ (upWalk_of_sepComp), which Lemma 4.3 excludes.
